summary: Staffing and recruiting professional with interviewing expertise, recruiting, personnel records maintenance, affirmative action compliance, fluent in [Language], detail-oriented, Microsoft Office Suite expert, people-oriented.

experience.title: HR Specialist
responsibilities: Assisted with the establishment of the hiring process used at George's Employment and Training Center.
Created and implemented the first electronic hiring process, reducing time to hire from 1 hour to 30 minutes.
Developed the first electronic application for production hiring.
Explained terms of position to new hires.
Onboarded new employees, administering paperwork, E-Verify, and I-9 Verification.
Maintained relationships with HR managers to stay abreast of hiring needs.
Coordinated driver-recruiting process.

experience.title: HR Specialist
responsibilities: Assisted managers with staffing and compliance for 16 area locations.
Ensured compliance training completion and tracked assignments, evaluations, system access, and terminations for a temp pool of over 100 people.
Developed and piloted the first electronic application for production hiring.
Collaborated to develop detailed processes for non-discretionary, discretionary, and professional hiring.
Reviewed I-9 and E-Verify for errors and completed E-Verify on new hires.
Used SAP, ADHOC, Training and Events, and e-Recruitment for data entry and reporting.

experience.title: HR/Benefits Clerk
responsibilities: Analyzed employment data and prepared required reports.
Developed reports on employee headcount, monthly HR reports, and quarterly training reports.
Managed all aspects of the employee life cycle, including onboarding and offboarding.
Communicated duties, compensation, benefits, and working conditions to new hires.
Ensured new hire files were complete and accurate.
Worked extensively in SAP and verified data accuracy.
Explained HR policies and procedures to employees.
Conducted exit interviews and managed 401(k), FMLA, and benefits administration.
Generated employee-tracking reports and managed orientation and open enrollment communications.

experience.title: HR Clerk
responsibilities: Maintained open position postings and customer service focus with employees and applicants.
Verified applicant references and employment history.
Handled routine inquiries via multiple line telephones.
Distributed employment documentation to plant locations.
Maintained accurate information on outgoing files.
Entered initial data and prepared for hire in SAP, including rejecting and updating recruitment side data.
Generated reports and verified application completeness.
Assisted applicants in completing applications and translated in Spanish when necessary.
Ensured compliance with all laws.

experience.title: Receptionist
responsibilities: Managed the receptionist area, greeting visitors and responding to telephone and in-person requests.
Maintained the front desk and reception area.
Served as central point of contact for outside vendors.
Handled copies, faxes, and correspondence.
Posted open positions and worked with a diverse labor pool.
Ensured application compliance and explained the application process.
Scheduled interviews and onboarding.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
responsibilities: Greeted and received visitors.
Answered heavy phone traffic.
Maintained inventory of office supplies.
Coordinated CPR classes for customers and staff.
Assisted staff in coordinating meetings and telephone conferences.
